boundary: only valid nonoverlapping patches from the parent's 60 training and 8 development people; reuse the admitted independent EOG reader for the four equipped development records; exclude shift, test and protected participants
tensor: input X [batch,15,400] at 200 Hz; score original X with frozen integer indices at the same position; S=P(S0), O=X-S
selection: for each branch independently choose the eligible training ID with highest mean signed unit-waveform template norm, mean alpha power fraction, and mean slow power fraction respectively; smallest ID breaks ties
attributes: mean-subtracted X, 400-point Hann periodogram, alpha [8,13) and slow [1,4) as fractions of [1,45] Hz
primary: validation member minus matched other ID in signed unshifted correlation to frozen training X template or selected band fraction; average paired differences within person, then equally across contributing people
null: zero mean matched difference; descriptive, no multiplicity-adjusted inference
matching: same dataset/person/site, nearest log X RMS, factor <=1.4; controls may repeat; no validation reselection
secondary: for each slow ID use frontal FP/AF sites and concurrent independent HEOG/VEOG; top quartile of whitened joint EOG mean-square across valid unique two-second epochs in each record; compare matched rates
pairs: for each orientation select most frequent anchor having two partners each with >=3 train people; use its two most frequent such partners; compare matched validation X alpha fractions within anchor; report support and examples even for sparse pairs
stopping: single frozen checkpoint, one census, report all six candidates and both orientations even if unsupported; exploratory reuse of the development partition
follow_up: post hoc specificity for both frozen alpha candidates on their original matched pairs. Training-only OLS per dataset/electrode for observed X alpha fraction using intercept, P(X) alpha fraction, P(X)/X mean square ratio, their product and log X RMS. Compare residual differences on development, no candidate reselection.
